reason: In GroupPermissionsV2.hasPermission (patch lines 668-679), the all-groups type resource is used only when no per-group resource is found by name, so evaluation runs against just one of the two. The per-group resource is created without a type (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:118-128), so DefaultPolicyEvaluator.java:73-80 never pulls in the all-groups policies, which means all-groups grants no longer apply to that group.
